Case: Patient D is a 51-year-old Black man with renal cell carcinoma status-post T4-T7 corpectomy and fusion for spine metastases 6 months ago who presents with progressive leg pain. Patient D states that the pain he had prior to his last surgery is returning and in a worse form. Specifically, he endorses that in addition to mid-back pain, he is experiencing shooting pains down both legs.
